verdict.rationale: incident.io documents and hosts an official remote MCP server (docs.incident.io/ai/remote-mcp) allowing any MCP-compatible AI assistant to connect and query incidents, alerts, on-call, and analytics; a live runtime probe confirms the hosted mcp.incident.io/mcp endpoint is real and enforces OAuth auth, corroborating the docs beyond marketing claims. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on report of successfully using the MCP server in production.
